description: Java unit test class AbstractConfigTest for testing the behavior of AbstractConfig, focusing on SSL/TLS key configuration options.

classes.name: AbstractConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for AbstractConfig, verifying SSL/TLS key and trust store configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an anonymous subclass instance of AbstractConfig.

methods.name: testPfxConfig
methods.description: Tests configuration using a PFX keystore file and verifies that the returned key cert options are of type PfxOptions.

methods.name: testPemConfig
methods.description: Tests configuration using PEM key and cert files and verifies that the key cert options are of type PemKeyCertOptions.

methods.name: testInvalidConfig1
methods.description: Overrides key format to PKCS12 while providing PEM files and expects null options.

methods.name: testInvalidConfig2
methods.description: Overrides keystore type to PEM while providing a keystore file and expects null options.

methods.name: testMissingFile1
methods.description: Tests behavior when the keystore file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMissingFile2
methods.description: Tests behavior when the key file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMissingFile3
methods.description: Tests behavior when the cert file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testMissingFile4
methods.description: Tests behavior when the trust store file does not exist; expects IllegalArgumentException.
